description: One country: metadata, counts, and a top sample of member providers (with the total). Use find_providers?country=slug for the full ranked list, or view=full here.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

slug.description: Country slug, as find_countries returns it, e.g. "united-kingdom".

name: get_country
